# hyperv_cloudinit_iso (Resource)

This resource allows you to manage Cloud-Init compatible ISO images on the Hyper-V host. The ISO is created with the volume label `cidata` for NoCloud datasource compatibility.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `destination_iso_file_path` (String) Remote path for the generated cloud-init ISO file.
- `meta_data` (String) Cloud-init meta-data content (YAML with instance-id, local-hostname, etc.).
- `user_data` (String) Cloud-init user-data content (typically #cloud-config YAML).

### Optional

- `network_config` (String) Cloud-init network-config content (Networking v2 YAML).
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `resolve_destination_iso_file_path` (String) The actual remote ISO file path that was used.
